## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`): the [DCO](../DCO) is the only paperwork.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm test` pass.
- [ ] New source files start with `// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0`; anything bundled from a third party is in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` and `NOTICE`.
- [ ] No token, real address, hostname or home path in code, fixtures or screenshots.
- [ ] A line under *Unreleased* in `CHANGELOG.md` if a person would notice.
